description_en: Queries the list of asset catalog entries. Online version: v6.1.0
description_zh: 查询资产目录列表，上线版本号：v6.1.0
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public list-catalog-assets --op-tenant-id 30001011 --list-catalog-assets-query AssetType=TABLE Keyword=abc PageNum=1 PageSize=10 QueryMode=EXACT_MATCH Name=abc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCatalogAssets

fields.help_en:
The asset type. Default value: TABLE. Valid values:
TABLE: table, including views and materialized views.
INDEX: technical metric.
BIZ_INDEX: business metric.
API: API.
PAGE: dashboard
fields.help_zh: 资产类型。默认为TABLE，枚举值：TABLE（表，包含视图、物化视图）、INDEX（技术指标）、BIZ_INDEX（业务指标）、API、PAGE（仪表板）
fields.name: asset_type

fields.help_en:
The query type. Determines whether to use name for exact matching or keyword for fuzzy search. Default value: EXACT_MATCH. Valid values:
EXACT_MATCH: exact match.
ASSET_SEARCH: fuzzy search
fields.help_zh: 查询类型；决定使用name精准匹配还是使用keyword模糊搜索。默认为EXACT_MATCH，枚举值：EXACT_MATCH（精准匹配）、ASSET_SEARCH（模糊搜索）
fields.name: query_mode

fields.help_en: The asset name. Used when queryMode is set to EXACT_MATCH. If this parameter is not specified, all assets are queried
fields.help_zh: 资产名称；queryMode=EXACT_MATCH（精准匹配）时使用。不填则默认查全量
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The search keyword. Used when queryMode is set to ASSET_SEARCH. Supports keyword matching against the asset full name, asset name, asset display name, and asset description. If this parameter is not specified, all assets are queried
fields.help_zh: 搜索关键词；queryMode=ASSET_SEARCH（模糊搜索）时使用，支持对资产全名、资产名称、资产展示名、资产描述做关键词匹配。不填默认查全量
fields.name: keyword

AssetFrom.description_en: The asset source. For TABLE (physical table), the value is in the format "Dataphin-workspace type-project Chinese name (project English name)". For TABLE (logical table), the value is in the format "Dataphin-workspace type-data domain Chinese name (data domain English name)". For TABLE (data source table), the value is in the format "source system name-data source name-database/schema name". For INDEX (standard modeling metric), the value is the asset source of the associated aggregate table. For INDEX (custom metric), the value is the asset source of the source table. For API, the value is the data service project name. For PAGE, the value is the application system name
AssetFrom.description_zh: 资产来源。TABLE（物理表）返回"Dataphin-空间类型-项目中文名（项目英文名）"；TABLE（逻辑表）返回"Dataphin-空间类型-数据板块中文名（数据板块英文名）"；TABLE（数据源表）返回"来源系统名-数据源名-Database/schema名"；INDEX（规范建模指标）返回所属汇总逻辑表的资产来源；INDEX（自定义指标）返回来源表的资产来源；API返回"数据服务项目名"；PAGE返回"应用系统名"
AssetFrom.title_zh: 资产来源。TABLE（物理表）返回"Dataphin-空间类型-项目中文名（项目英文名）"；TABLE（逻辑表）返回"Dataphin-空间类型-数据板块中文名（数据板块英文名）"；TABLE（数据源表）返回"来源系统名-数据源名-Database/schema名"；INDEX（规范建模指标）返回所属汇总逻辑表的资产来源；INDEX（自定义指标）返回来源表的资产来源；API返回"数据服务项目名"；PAGE返回"应用系统名"
